description: Choose how to identify people, then collect their public phone numbers and personal or work emails from public records and published pages. Every contact is returned with its source, match evidence and confidence score.

contactTypes.description: Only these contact types are returned. anyPhone includes mobiles, landlines, VoIP and toll-free numbers.
contactTypes.sectionDescription: Control which contacts are kept and how confident a match must be.
contactTypes.title: Wanted contact types

countries.description: ISO country codes to search. US public-record people search and the NPI registry run for US people; other countries use profile, website and registry data.
countries.title: Countries

crawlDepth.description: 1 reads the home and contact pages; 2 also follows contact links found on those pages. Only public pages on the same site are read.
crawlDepth.title: Website crawl depth

emails.description: Work or personal email addresses. Each address is matched to a public Gravatar profile and public commit history, then to public records when a name is resolved.
emails.title: Email addresses

facebookProfiles.description: Public Facebook profile URLs. Only information visible without a login is used.
facebookProfiles.title: Facebook profile URLs

includeNotFound.description: Include a row with the sources checked and a reason when no public contact passes the filters.
includeNotFound.title: Report people with nothing found

leads.description: Rows copied from another actor or a CSV. Columns are mapped automatically by common names such as name, email, company, website, city, state, linkedinUrl, facebookUrl, githubUsername and xHandle.
leads.title: Lead rows

leadsDatasetId.description: Optional Apify dataset ID to read lead rows from. It is combined with the rows above.
leadsDatasetId.title: Lead dataset ID

leadsFieldMapping.description: Optional override when a dataset uses different column names. Example: {"fullName": "contact_name", "email": "work_email"}.

city.description: Column name that contains the city value.
city.title: City

company.description: Column name that contains the company value.
company.title: Company

companyDomain.description: Column name that contains the companyDomain value.
companyDomain.title: Company Domain

country.description: Column name that contains the country value.
country.title: Country

email.description: Column name that contains the email value.
email.title: Email

facebookUrl.description: Column name that contains the facebookUrl value.
facebookUrl.title: Facebook Url

fullName.description: Column name that contains the fullName value.
fullName.title: Full Name

githubUsername.description: Column name that contains the githubUsername value.
githubUsername.title: Github Username

linkedinUrl.description: Column name that contains the linkedinUrl value.
linkedinUrl.title: Linkedin Url

phone.description: Column name that contains the phone value.
phone.title: Phone

state.description: Column name that contains the state value.
state.title: State

title.description: Column name that contains the title value.
title.title: Title

xHandle.description: Column name that contains the xHandle value.
xHandle.title: X Handle

leadsFieldMapping.title: Lead column mapping

linkedinProfiles.description: Public LinkedIn profile URLs. The actor reads the public profile page without a login.
linkedinProfiles.title: LinkedIn profile URLs

maxMatchesPerPerson.description: How many public-record candidates to open when scoring a people-search match. Only the best unambiguous match is used.
maxMatchesPerPerson.title: People-search candidates per person

minMatchConfidence.description: Contacts below this score (0-100) are dropped. Higher values reduce wrong-person matches.
minMatchConfidence.title: Minimum match confidence

mode.description: How the people in this run are identified. Pick the mode that matches the field you fill in.
mode.sectionDescription: Fill the field that matches the selected mode. The other mode fields can stay empty.
mode.title: Input mode

onlyWithEmail.description: Drop people for whom no personal or work email passes the filters.
onlyWithEmail.sectionDescription: Control record count and whether empty results are reported.
onlyWithEmail.title: Only people with an email

people.description: One row per person. Full name is required; city and state or a company domain help disambiguate common names. Optional profile URLs and social handles enrich the identity graph.

company.description: Employer name, used as an identity hint.
company.title: Company

companyDomain.description: Company website, for example acme.com. Used to crawl public team and contact pages.
companyDomain.title: Company domain

country.description: ISO country code, for example US or GB.
country.title: Country

facebookUrl.description: Public Facebook profile URL, if known.
facebookUrl.title: Facebook profile URL

fullName.description: First and last name, for example Jane Doe.
fullName.title: Full name

linkedinUrl.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL, if known.
linkedinUrl.title: LinkedIn profile URL

state.description: US state code or name, for example TX or Texas.
state.title: State or region

title.description: Current job title, used as an identity hint.
title.title: Job title

xHandle.description: Public X (Twitter) handle without the @, if known.
xHandle.title: X handle

people.title: People

socialHandles.description: A known handle per person. Handles are resolved directly, not guessed.

handle.description: Handle without @, or the full public profile URL.
handle.title: Handle or URL

socialHandles.title: Social handles

suppressionList.description: Emails, phone numbers or full names that must never be returned, for opt-outs. Use @domain.com to suppress every email at a domain.
suppressionList.sectionDescription: Suppressed values are removed before output; a fully suppressed person is reported without their details.
suppressionList.title: Suppression list

websiteCrawl.description: Read public contact, about and team pages on the person's own site and the company domain for emails and phones.
websiteCrawl.sectionDescription: Choose how far to follow public website links.
websiteCrawl.title: Crawl personal and company websites

title: Contact Finder input
